units.source_text: 以古代的圣者，或近年的心灵学者来说，考虑人类灵魂的人，一般都是尊重人的灵魂，轻视其他动植物的。

en.t: From ancient sages to more recent spiritualists, those who think about the human soul have generally respected the souls of human beings while looking down on other animals and plants.

units.source_text: 人类经历数千年，企图从种种意义上将人类与自然界万物加以区别，并且一味盲目地向这个方向走去。

en.t: Over thousands of years, humanity has tried in all kinds of ways to distinguish human beings from everything else in nature, and has blindly kept moving in that direction.
